color.note: photo - grey chassis, dark craft band, silver-grey modules

front.note: photo - the studio front photograph at 1.264 px/mm: craft at y 48, the short upper cage (RCB 0, SFB 0-7, RCB 1) at y 109-291 on the 1.264 px/mm scale, ten 43.18 mm slots over the line-card slots (#902; it was at y 143 over ~170 mm), the double label strip, ten MPC slots at y 352 over ~425 mm, the LC strip, the cable-manager panel and the intake grille. The photographed unit carries MX2000-LC-BLANK covers in every slot, so the MPC catalogue rides on the MX2000 gap

lc-slots.note: each LC slot is the line-card adapter's face, 43.18 x 449.8 (1.7 x 17.71 in, the guide's ADC row), on its own width as pitch: ten slots, 431.8 mm, centred on the chassis at x 4.1 (#261). Four readings put the pitch there: the MX2010 front gives 41.36 px between slots against a 379.5 px MPC plate, 43.3 mm on the card's 396.0; the MX2008 front, isotropic at 1.264 px/mm once its flanges are taken as the 19 in, gives 54.7 px, 43.3 mm; the MX2020 front gives 31.9 px at 0.744 px/mm, 43.4 mm. Until #261 the slots were an estimated 41.0 x 425.0 on a 41.0 pitch, which no adapter fits. The native MX2K cards and the blank keep their estimated 41 x 425 and are centred in the wider slot. Down: the slot is centred on the photograph's LC cage, 331.5 to 791.9 mm (476 to 1058 px at 1.264 px/mm from the chassis top at 57 px): y 336.8. The band above it, which carries the RCB/SFB and LC legends, closes up to 313.0 to 336.8, and the band below to 788.0 to 806.0.

power.note: datasheet-table - the guide power overview: nine PSMs at 2500 W each, 8+1, over a 22.5 kW pool with 2.5 kW held for redundancy. Table 25 (base AC power requirements) gives the base system - excluding MPCs, ADCs and MICs, and listing seven SFBs, one RCB, two fan trays, the craft interface, three PSMs and two PDMs - 1,520 W typical at 25 C and 4,420 W at 55 C; carried as power-typical-w and power-max-w, envelope bare. The row names no side. It does not reconcile with the FRU tables: Table 41 rates each MX2000-FANTRAY-S at 1500 W typical, so two trays alone exceed the 1,520 W base - recorded, not resolved. The DC and HVAC/HVDC thermal examples (Tables 112 and 117) assume 34.5 kW of output for a loaded chassis, which is the MX2020 figure and exceeds this chassis's own 22.5 kW pool; it is not carried
